checks.name: Cloudflare production worker remains authoritative behind the autonomy wrapper
checks.detail: wrangler.toml must deploy src/worker-production-autonomy.js, which must delegate every fetch unchanged to src/worker-production.js and add only bounded scheduled AI maintenance

checks.name: Cloudflare Assets are authoritative
checks.detail: Cloudflare Assets must serve _site

checks.name: Cloudflare D1 membership database is bound
checks.detail: MEMBERS_DB must remain the membership authority

checks.name: Worker runs before protected assets
checks.detail: Authenticated API and protected download patterns must reach the Worker before static assets, while ordinary public assets may remain direct

checks.name: Production router dispatches email lifecycle

checks.name: Production router dispatches PayPal lifecycle
checks.detail: PayPal routes must use worker-paypal-subscriptions.js

checks.name: Production router dispatches member experience

checks.name: Production router protects member assets

checks.name: Cloudflare Worker canonicalizes www to apex

checks.name: Login writes current secure session cookie

checks.name: Logout clears current and legacy cookies
checks.detail: Logout must clear both cookie generations

checks.name: Member dashboard accepts current and legacy cookies

checks.name: PayPal accepts current and legacy cookies

checks.name: Protected assets accept current and legacy cookies

checks.detail: The membership page must recognise modern and legacy paid access

checks.name: Newsletter consent remains explicit

checks.name: Membership requests include credentials

checks.name: Dashboard requests include credentials
checks.detail: Dashboard reads, writes and logout must retain the active session
